# Contributing to SecureCall

## How to Contribute

1. Fork the repository
2. Create a feature branch: `git checkout -b feat/your-feature`
3. Make your changes
4. Test on a real Android device
5. Submit a Pull Request to `main`

## Rules

- All PRs require review before merging
- Follow existing code style and naming conventions
- Test your changes on Android 7.0+ devices
- Do not commit secrets, API keys, or credentials
- Do not include `.env` files or `google-services.json`

## Bug Reports

Use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/NeaBouli/stealth/issues) with:
- Device model and Android version
- Steps to reproduce
- Expected vs actual behavior
- Logcat output if applicable

## Security Issues

See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for reporting vulnerabilities.
